claims.text: gRPC is an open-source high-performance RPC framework initiated by Google and hosted by the CNCF.
Protocol Buffers define strict schemas and serialize messages into compact binary payloads, bypassing JSON string parsing and field redundancy.
gRPC uses HTTP/2 transport to multiplex concurrent streams across a single persistent TCP connection, preventing HTTP/1.1 head-of-line blocking.
gRPC supports unary request-response alongside server, client, and bidirectional streaming over the same multiplexed connection.
gRPC delivers high throughput and type safety for internal backend microservices, while REST remains standard for public browser-facing endpoints.
